# Toy Sourcing Partner

> Your trusted toy sourcing partner in Chenghai, China. We supply beach toys, bubble toys, remote control toys and building blocks for importers, distributors, wholesalers and retail chains worldwide. OEM/ODM customization, wholesale supply and global export from China's toy capital.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/): Product overview, company introduction and global sourcing capability
- [Products](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/products): Browse all toy categories and individual products
- [Beach Toys](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/products/beach-toys): Beach buckets, sand toys, shovels, rakes and outdoor play sets
- [Bubble Toys](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/products/bubble-toys): Bubble wands, bubble guns, automatic bubble machines and accessories
- [RC Toys](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/products/rc-toys): RC cars, stunt cars, RC trucks, racing cars and RC helicopters
- [Building Blocks](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/products/building-blocks): Plastic building blocks, educational STEM blocks and construction sets
- [OEM & Customization](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/oem): Custom product development, logo printing, packaging and mold services
- [Factory & Supply Chain](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/factory): Chenghai toy supply chain, production coordination and quality control
- [Quality & Certifications](https://www.toysourcingpartner.com/quality): Material inspection, in-process QC, finished product inspection and certification support

## Key Facts

- **Location**: Chenghai District, Shantou, Guangdong, China — the world's toy capital
- **Main Products**: Beach toys, bubble toys, remote control toys, plastic building blocks
- **Services**: Product sourcing, OEM/ODM, custom packaging, quality control, export documentation
- **MOQ**: Typically 100–500 pieces per item; varies by product and customization
- **Markets**: North America, Europe, Middle East, South America, Asia Pacific
- **Response Time**: Within 24 hours
